prompts.frame:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent PNG cutout door-frame layer for a philosophy-cat narrative website.
Primary request: ONE EMPTY DOUBLE-DOOR FRAME, strictly straight-on front elevation, completely rectangular with a flat top. Overall outer frame has width-to-height ratio about 1.45:1, a broad doorway. There are NO door leaves inside it.
Composition/framing: center the complete freestanding frame with narrow transparent margins. Inner opening is a very large simple rectangle, about 86% of the outer frame width and 90% of the outer frame height. Modest narrow jambs and lintel, an extremely thin sill. Nothing protrudes outward. The whole inner opening must be actually transparent alpha, the same as the exterior background: this is an empty cutout frame to place over other artwork.
Style/medium: warm storybook hand-inked drawing with slightly sketchy charcoal-black contours, restrained sparse pencil detail. Flat opaque warm ivory paper surface #f8f7f3 on the frame members only, subtle paper grain only within those surfaces. Crisp enough for web use but human-drawn rather than geometric vector-perfect.
Constraints: actual RGBA transparent background exterior AND inside the rectangular opening; preserve opacity only for the frame artwork. No people, no cats, no words, no lettering, no symbols, no doors, no hinges, no room, no background, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow, no ornamental portal, no arch, no perspective, no photorealism, no backdrop, no painted checkerboard. Single isolated asset only.
prompts.leaf:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent PNG cutout single door-leaf layer for a philosophy-cat narrative website, animated as part of double doors.
Primary request: ONE SINGLE OPAQUE IVORY DOOR LEAF, strictly straight-on front elevation, perfectly flat rectangular overall shape, width-to-height ratio about 0.72:1. No surrounding door frame.
Composition/framing: complete door leaf centered, nearly fills the image with narrow transparent margins. Tall rectangle. Small dark simple handle near the right edge at about mid-height. Sparse simple rectangular inset molding: one tall restrained rectangular inset or two plain rectangular panels. Keep the silhouette rectangular.
Style/medium: warm storybook hand-inked drawing, restrained slightly sketchy charcoal-black outer contour and thinner sparse pencil detail matching a hand-drawn ivory door frame. Door surface is solid opaque warm ivory paper #f8f7f3 with very subtle paper grain. Human-drawn lines without excess doodling.
Constraints: true transparent alpha exterior; the entire leaf surface must remain opaque ivory, including inset panels. No frame, no second door, no room, no people, no cats, no text, no floor, no cast shadow, no backdrop, no scene, no ornate portal, no perspective, no photorealism, no painted checkerboard. Single isolated asset only. This leaf will be mirrored and joined with a duplicate in CSS, so keep simple front-facing orthographic geometry.
